title: Hip and Groin Pain — What to Test, What to Rule Out

hook.en: Hip and groin pain has many causes: the joint, the labrum, a tendon, a stress fracture, the spine, even the abdomen. Learn a clear order of examination and the signs that mean "do not just treat".
hook.ur: Hip aur groin ke dard ki bohat si wajuhat hain: joint, labrum, tendon, stress fracture, spine, hatta ke pait. Examination ki saaf tartib seekhein aur woh nishaniyan jin ka matlab hai "sirf treat na karein".

goal.en: By the end, you'll sort hip pain into joint, tendon, groin and referred causes, use the FADIR, FABER and scour tests with their limits in mind, and recognise a possible femoral neck stress fracture or slipped capital femoral epiphysis.
goal.ur: End tak aap hip ke dard ko joint, tendon, groin aur referred wajuhat mein baantein ge, FADIR, FABER aur scour tests unki hadood ke saath istemal karenge, aur femoral neck stress fracture ya slipped capital femoral epiphysis pehchanenge.

text.en: Begin with **where the patient points**. A hand cupped around the side of the hip (the "C sign") suggests the **joint**; pain on the outside over the bony point is usually the **tendons** of the buttock muscles; pain deep in the **groin** needs the most care. Then ask about **clicking, catching, giving way** and what **load** brings it on. Only after this do you choose tests.
text.ur: Shuru karein is se ke **patient kahan ishara karta hai**. Hip ke side par hath ka ghera (**C sign**) **joint** ki taraf ishara hai; bahar ki taraf haddi ke ubhaar par dard aam taur par gluteal muscles ke **tendons** ka hota hai; gehra **groin** ka dard sab se zyada ehtiyat maangta hai. Phir **click, atakna, jawab dena** aur kaun sa **load** dard laata hai poochhein. Is ke baad hi tests chunein.

text.en: Think of the hip as a ball in a cup lined with a rubber seal (the **labrum**). If the ball presses on the seal in the front when the knee is brought up and turned in, the groin hurts. That is why the **FADIR** position (flexion, adduction, internal rotation) is so sensitive: it squeezes the front of the joint, whatever is the cause.
text.ur: Hip ko ek gend samjhein jo ek pyaale mein hai, jiske kinare par rabar ki seal (**labrum**) hai. Ghutna oopar la kar andar ghumane par gend aage seal ko dabati hai aur groin dukhti hai. Isi liye **FADIR** position (flexion, adduction, internal rotation) bohat sensitive hai: yeh joint ke agle hisse ko dabati hai, wajah koi bhi ho.

steps.title: Listen and look
steps.detail: Ask where the pain is, what provokes it and any clicking or giving way. Watch walking and a single-leg stand: a pelvis that drops points to weak hip abductors. || Sunein aur dekhein

steps.title: Move the joint
steps.detail: Measure hip flexion and internal and external rotation in lying and compare sides. Pain with loss of internal rotation points to the joint itself. || Joint ko hilayein

steps.title: Provoke the joint
steps.detail: Use FADIR (pain in the groin), FABER (pain at the groin or back) and the scour test. A negative FADIR makes an impingement or labral problem unlikely; a positive one alone does not prove it. || Joint ko provoke karein

steps.title: Test the tendons and look further
steps.detail: Resisted abduction and the single-leg stand load the buttock tendons; palpate the outer hip. Check the spine and, if the story fits, the abdomen. || Tendons test karein aur aage dekhein

question.en: A patient has groin pain and a negative FADIR test. What does this most reasonably tell you?
question.ur: Patient ko groin ka dard hai aur FADIR test negative hai. Yeh sab se munasib taur par aap ko kya batata hai?

feedback.en: A negative FADIR says nothing like that.
feedback.ur: Negative FADIR aisi koi baat nahi kehta.

text.en: Femoroacetabular impingement or a labral tear is unlikely
text.ur: Femoroacetabular impingement ya labral tear kam mumkin hai

feedback.en: Yes — FADIR is very sensitive, so a negative result makes these problems less likely.
feedback.ur: Haan — FADIR bohat sensitive hai, is liye negative result in masail ko kam mumkin banata hai.

text.en: The hip joint is proven healthy
text.ur: Hip joint bilkul theek sabit ho gaya

feedback.en: A single test cannot prove that.
feedback.ur: Ek test yeh sabit nahi kar sakta.

rows.en: Outer hip over the bony point
rows.ur: Hip ke bahar haddi ke ubhaar par

rows.en: Painful, restricted internal rotation, positive FADIR
rows.ur: Dardnak, mehdood internal rotation, positive FADIR

rows.en: Pain on resisted abduction and single-leg stand
rows.ur: Resisted abduction aur ek taang par khara hone par dard

rows.en: Load management and hip strengthening, check for arthritis or impingement
rows.ur: Load management aur hip ki strengthening, arthritis ya impingement dekhein

rows.en: Load management, avoid compression, graded strengthening
rows.ur: Load management, dabao se bachein, darje war strengthening

text.en: **Groin pain = think twice.** Pain deep in the groin from a stress fracture, a slipped epiphysis or the abdomen can look like a "pulled muscle". Ask about night pain, a limp and a recent rise in running or load before you reassure.
text.ur: **Groin ka dard = do baar sochein.** Stress fracture, slipped epiphysis ya pait ka gehra groin dard "kheeche hue muscle" jaisa lag sakta hai. Tasalli dene se pehle raat ke dard, langar aur haal hi mein daurne ya load ke izafe ke baare mein poochhein.

text.en: **Treating a positive FADIR as a diagnosis.** FADIR is sensitive but not specific: it is painful in many conditions. Use it to rule problems out, and read it together with the history and range of movement.
text.ur: **Positive FADIR ko diagnosis samajhna.** FADIR sensitive hai magar specific nahi: yeh bohat si halaton mein dardnak hota hai. Isko masail rule out karne ke liye istemal karein aur history aur range ke saath parhein.

question.en: Which finding should make you suspect a femoral neck stress fracture?
question.ur: Kaun si finding femoral neck stress fracture ka shak paida kare?

text.ur: Baithne ke baad hamstrings ka khichao

text.en: Pain on the outer hip when lying on that side only
text.ur: Sirf us side par letne se hip ke bahar dard

feedback.ur: Yeh tendon ke dard se zyada milta hai.

text.en: Groin pain after a sudden rise in running, with pain on hopping and at night
text.ur: Achanak daurne mein izafe ke baad groin dard, hopping aur raat ko dard ke saath

feedback.en: Yes — load-related deep groin pain with night pain needs imaging before loading.
feedback.ur: Haan — load se jura gehra groin dard raat ke dard ke saath loading se pehle imaging maangta hai.

question.en: A 13-year-old with a limp has knee pain and a stiff, externally rotated hip. What is the safest action?
question.ur: 13 saal ka bacha langar ke saath knee ka dard rakhta hai aur hip akhra hua aur bahar ghuma hua hai. Sab se mehfooz qadam kya hai?

text.en: Reassure and review in a month
text.ur: Tasalli dein aur ek mahine baad review karein

feedback.ur: Yeh der nuqsandeh ho sakti hai.

text.en: Stop weight-bearing and refer urgently for imaging
text.ur: Wazan daalna band karein aur imaging ke liye foran refer karein

feedback.en: Yes — a slipped capital femoral epiphysis can look like knee pain and needs urgent care.
feedback.ur: Haan — slipped capital femoral epiphysis knee ke dard jaisa lag sakta hai aur foran care maangta hai.

feedback.en: The knee is only where the pain is felt.
feedback.ur: Knee sirf woh jagah hai jahan dard mehsoos hota hai.

text.en: **Examine above and below.** Hip pain is often referred from the lower back, and knee pain from the hip. Check the spine and the knee as part of every hip examination, and give a clear plan: what you think, what you will do and when you will review.
text.ur: **Oopar aur neeche bhi dekhein.** Hip ka dard aksar kamar se aata hai aur knee ka dard hip se. Har hip examination mein spine aur knee dekhein, aur saaf plan dein: aap kya sochte hain, kya karenge aur kab review karenge.

question.en: Why is a negative FADIR more useful than a positive one?
question.ur: Negative FADIR positive se zyada mufeed kyun hai?

answer.en: Because FADIR is highly sensitive but not specific. Almost everyone with an impingement or labral problem has a positive FADIR, so a negative result makes these unlikely; but many other conditions also hurt in that position, so a positive result proves little.
answer.ur: Kyunke FADIR bohat sensitive hai magar specific nahi. Impingement ya labral masle wale lagbhag sab mein FADIR positive hota hai, is liye negative result in ko kam mumkin banata hai; magar aur bhi bohat si halatein us position mein dukhti hain, is liye positive result kam sabit karta hai.

beats.patient: A 24-year-old footballer has deep groin pain with deep squats and sitting. Hip internal rotation is painful and reduced, and FADIR is positive. There is no night pain or limp.
beats.assessment: Positive FADIR with painful, reduced internal rotation and a clear story fits a hip joint problem such as impingement, but is not a diagnosis by itself.
beats.treatment: Explain the picture, reduce the provoking positions, start hip and trunk strengthening and agree on a review in six weeks; refer for imaging if there is no progress.
beats.reassess: After eight weeks he squats with much less pain and returns to training; imaging is not needed.

text.en: **Refer urgently** for a child or teenager with a limp or knee pain and a stiff hip, groin pain with night pain after a rise in running (possible stress fracture), a hot swollen hip with fever, a sudden inability to bear weight after a fall, or groin pain with abdominal, urinary or testicular symptoms. Do not do the hop test if a stress fracture is suspected.
text.ur: **Foran refer karein** bachay ya teenager ko langar ya knee ka dard aur akhra hua hip, daurne mein izafe ke baad raat ke dard ke saath groin dard (mumkin stress fracture), garam sooja hip bukhar ke saath, girne ke baad achanak wazan na utha pana, ya groin ka dard pait, peshab ya testicle ki alamaat ke saath. Stress fracture ka shak ho to hop test na karein.

summary.en: Sort hip pain by where the patient points: a C sign suggests the joint, outer hip pain the tendons, and deep groin pain needs the most care.
summary.ur: Hip ke dard ko is se baantein ke patient kahan ishara karta hai: C sign joint ki taraf, bahar ka dard tendons ki taraf, aur gehra groin dard sab se zyada ehtiyat maangta hai.

summary.en: FADIR is sensitive but not specific, so a negative result helps most; read every test with the history and range of movement.
summary.ur: FADIR sensitive hai magar specific nahi, is liye negative result zyada mufeed hai; har test ko history aur range ke saath parhein.

summary.en: Think twice about groin pain: a stress fracture, a slipped epiphysis or an abdominal cause needs referral, not just exercises.
summary.ur: Groin ke dard par do baar sochein: stress fracture, slipped epiphysis ya pait ki wajah ko sirf exercises nahi balkay referral chahiye.

front.ur: Kaun si teenage problem knee ke dard jaisi lag sakti hai?

back.ur: Hip ka slipped capital femoral epiphysis.

front.en: Where should you also examine in hip pain?
front.ur: Hip ke dard mein aur kahan examine karna chahiye?

back.en: The lumbar spine and the knee.
